# `company.batches`

Reversible batches: multi-record imports and modifications, each undone as one unit while nothing later depends on it. Never deleted; only state and the reversal columns change.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this batch. |
| `kind` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | What made it: import, bulk-edit, bank-import, reversal... |
| `scope` | VARCHAR(200) | no | — | — | ix_batches_scope | — | What "newest first" is measured in (an account for a bank import). |
| `ordering` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | strict: refused while a later live batch exists in its scope; record: judged per record. |
| `label` | VARCHAR(200) | no | — | — | — | — | What the batch was, as a person reads it. |
| `state` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | live, reversing, reversed or reversed_partly. |
| `source_type` | VARCHAR(32) | yes | — | — | — | — | What the batch came from (import_run); null for none. |
| `source_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | The run it came from; null for none. |
| `reversal_of` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | batches.id | For a reversal batch, the batch it reverses; null otherwise. |
| `actor_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal that made the batch. |
| `actor_kind` | VARCHAR(16) | yes | — | — | — | — | human or agent. |
| `via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface it was made through. |
| `on_behalf_of` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | The human an agent acted for; null otherwise. |
| `reason` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Why, as given; null when none. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | ix_batches_scope | — | UTC time the batch was opened. |
| `reversed_by` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | batches.id | The reversal batch that undid it; null while live. |
| `reversed_at` | VARCHAR(32) | yes | — | — | — | — | UTC time its reversal began; null while live. |
| `reversal_reason` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Why it was reversed; null while live. |
| `reversal_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that finished the reversal; null until then. |
